items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: I used to play with him. ... So I played with him, Budd and I. Bud played with him

ctx.x: How was the schooling? Did all that touring interfere with your --

The schooling? We had the schools. I went to Fred Douglass High. That was one of our black leaders, you know, a slave. And Booker T. Washington. Now that was Booker Pitman's grandfather, who was a great saxophone player at one time. I used to play with him. He died in South America. He came up -- he left here around 1931 and went to Europe and he didn't come back until '62. Jack Paar brought him back, he and his daughter, during the time they played "Girl from Ipanema."
